theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: One brand color drives the whole kit — panels, register, and kitchen screens all take this restaurant's colors.
theme.app_hint: Skins the /restaurants panel itself — the color, surface, and corners of these admin screens. Each restaurant still has its own franchise theme, set on its page.
admin.groups_hint: This restaurant can only cook & sell recipes in its groups. Ungrouped recipes are always available.
admin.groups_none: No groups — only ungrouped recipes are available.
admin.no_restaurants: No restaurants yet. Create one above.
admin.seating_hint: A seat is an invisible sit point — place it on one of this restaurant's chairs and players get a “Sit” prompt there.
admin.stations_hint: Each station places either a physical world prop or a virtual point. A virtual point is an invisible prompt that fades the player into this restaurant's shell kitchen with that station inside; each point keeps its own cooking state. Placing closes this panel so you can position it in the world.
admin.subtitle: Server-wide management
admin.virtual_needs_shell: Place the kitchen shell first (button above) to enable virtual points.
admin.shell_placed: Kitchen shell placed — Virtual stations open inside it.
admin.no_shell: No kitchen shell yet. Place it to enable Virtual stations; it anchors above the counter.
admin.shell_needs_counter: Set the counter first — the shell anchors to it (and to the blip).
admin.virtual_hint: A virtual point is an invisible prompt — using it fades the player into this restaurant's shell kitchen with that station inside. Each point keeps its own cooking state.
admin.title: Restaurant Administration
branding.cropper_hint: Drag the frame · pull a corner to resize.
branding.default_image_hint: Direct image URL. Each item without its own photo below shows this, auto-cropped (centred) to fit its shape. Leave blank to reset.
branding.default_image_placeholder: https://…/logo.png — used on any packaging without its own photo below
branding.paste_url_prompt: Paste an image URL above to position it.
cook.box_empty_closed_hint: Click the box to open the lid, then drop a pizza inside.
cook.box_empty_open_hint: Drop a pizza inside — click the box to close the lid.
cook.box_full_hint: Grab the box to move it — box it up, or take the pizza back out.
cook.boxed_pizza_meal: Boxed pizza — sets down as its box
cook.drag_cooked_here: Drag a cooked item here to collect it
cook.draghint_box_down: Drop on the table to set the box down
cook.draghint_prep_apart: Drop on the prep table to take it apart
cook.draghint_prep_stack: Drop on the prep table — or onto another item to stack
cook.draghint_restack: Drag onto another item to stack — drop on the bar to remove
cook.draghint_rub_tube: Rub the tube over a cooked item on the table until fully coated
cook.draghint_tray_down: Drop on the table to set the tray down
cook.draghint_tray_meal: Drop on the bar to make it a meal — or set the tray down elsewhere
cook.hint_click_tap_pour: Click a tap to pour — the middle tap adds ice
cook.hint_drag_bar_collect: Drag it to the bar to collect
cook.hint_drag_lid_finish: Drag a lid onto the cup to finish it
cook.hint_raise_basket: Raise the basket to take it out
cook.inghint_drink: Drag the cup under a tap, then click the tap to pour (middle tap = ice).
cook.inghint_finish: Pick a flavor, then rub the tube over a cooked item on the table until fully coated.
cook.inghint_fryer: Drag into the fryer basket to cook.
cook.inghint_lid: Drag onto a filled cup to press the lid on.
cook.inghint_pizzabox: Drag onto the table — click the lid to open it, drop a pizza in, then box it up.
cook.inghint_prep: Drag onto the table — stack parts to build recipes.
cook.inghint_stovetop: Drag onto the cooktop or into an open oven door.
cook.inghint_topping: Drag onto a cooked patty to add it.
cook.inghint_tray: Drag onto the table — arrange food on it, then make it a meal.
cook.no_cooked_items: No cooked items yet — cook something and collect it.
cook.no_ingredients: No ingredients in stock for this station. A manager buys raw ingredients in Management → Supplies.
cook.no_uncooked_items: No uncooked items here. Raw ingredients you've stocked live in the Ingredients tab — this tab is for assembled items (e.g. a pizza built at the prep table).
cook.serving_tray_meal: Serving-tray meal — sets down as arranged
cook.station_fryer_hint: Drop food into a basket, then click that basket to lower it into the oil. Click it again to raise it and take the food out.
cook.station_prep_hint: Stack ingredients on the table, then hover a stack to pick a recipe and make it.
cook.station_soda_hint: Drag a cup under a tap and click the tap to pour — the middle tap adds ice. Press a lid on, then drag the drink to the bar.
cook.station_stovetop_hint: Grill patties on the cooktop (click to flip); open a door to bake cookies, cakes & pizzas inside.
cook.tray_empty_hint: Drag food onto the tray to arrange a meal. Grab the tray to move it.
cook.tray_full_hint: Grab the tray to move it — or drop it on the bar to make the meal.
cook.trayhint_build: Drag onto the table to build with it.
cook.trayhint_burnt: Burnt — discard it below, or keep it in your inventory.
cook.trayhint_cook_fryer: Drag into the fryer basket to cook it.
cook.trayhint_cook_oven: Drag into an open oven door to bake it.
cook.trayhint_decompose: Drag onto the table to take it apart, or stack it as a layer.
cook.trayhint_in_inventory: In your inventory — ready to stock or sell.
cook.trayhint_meal: Drag onto the table to set the meal down — exactly as it was arranged.
cook.trayhint_still_raw: Still raw — cook it at the %s.
cook.trayhint_take: Take it into your inventory to stock or sell it.
mgmt.no_seats: No seats placed. Players sit on your interior's own chairs at the points you place.
mgmt.no_sellables: Nothing to sell yet — add recipes or assign this restaurant a group.
mgmt.price_list_hint: Set a price on everything this restaurant can sell. Price 0 or disabled = not orderable at the register.
mgmt.seat_hint: Placing a seat closes this panel so you can position it in the world.
mgmt.virtual_needs_shell: An admin must place this restaurant's kitchen shell before Virtual stations can be spawned.
mgmt.virtual_hint: A virtual point is an invisible prompt — using it fades the player into the shell kitchen with that station inside. Each point keeps its own cooking state.
mgmt.deposit_stock_hint: Move this many from your inventory into the shared stock.
mgmt.withdraw_stock_hint: Take this many out of the shared stock into your inventory.
mgmt.no_supplies: No ingredients configured to buy. Add ingredient costs in the admin Settings.
mgmt.price_default_hint: Default %s (from ingredient cost). Blank to use it.
mgmt.supplies_hint: Buy raw ingredients into the restaurant's shared stock, or deposit/withdraw them straight to and from your own inventory. The kitchen cooks from this stock; buying is paid out of the restaurant balance.
mgmt.title: Management
payconfirm.title: %s — Order
recipes.dual_sided: Dual-sided (two cookable faces — click to flip; each side cooks independently)
recipes.expiry_hint: How long the cooked item stays fresh in the tray before it spoils.
recipes.group_hint: Limits this recipe to restaurants carrying this group. Blank = every restaurant.
recipes.intro: Cookable recipes. Items are picked from the server catalogue — a recipe with a missing item is flagged and hidden in-game until fixed.
menu.intro: Everything on your menu — cooked recipes, assembled foods, drinks and finishes — grouped by category. Prices default from ingredient cost; tune per-restaurant in Management.
recipes.pick_input_hint: — pick an input item to start saving
register.empty_cart: Tap items to add them to the order.
register.no_catalog: Nothing to sell yet — set prices in Management, and make sure the items are installed (run /restaurants_items).
register.title: Register
settings.admin_command_hint: Chat command admins run to open this panel.
settings.assembly_desc: Kitchen-prep recipes: combine component items into a finished item.
settings.blip_desc: Default blip applied to new restaurants.
settings.cooked_expiry_hint: Default freshness window for collected cooked items before they spoil in the tray. 0 = never. A recipe's own expiry overrides this.
settings.drinks_desc: Soda-machine taps: the first six drinks appear left-to-right on the fountain (the middle nozzle always dispenses ice). A cup item is filled at the tap into the drink item.
settings.economy_desc: Currency, opening balance, commission and the default profit margin.
settings.profit_margin_hint: Menu prices default to an item's ingredient cost plus this margin. Bosses can override per-restaurant.
settings.pricing_desc: What each raw ingredient costs the restaurant to buy. Drives restock spend and the default menu price (cost + profit margin).
settings.reset_recipes_desc: Delete every recipe and restore the built-in defaults. Custom recipes and edits are lost.
settings.reset_recipes_confirm: This deletes all recipes and restores defaults. Continue?
settings.group_field_hint: Limits this to restaurants carrying this group. Blank = every restaurant.
settings.finish_cost_hint: Bought via Supplies (stock) and drives the default menu price. 0 = free.
settings.label: Label
settings.modifiers_hint: Customer options at the register (add cheese, no lettuce). 'Default' items are on the base build; each can add a price.
settings.roles_desc: The role ladder new restaurants start with. Owners can customise their own later.
